blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Even as Nxled continues to establish itself as one of the PVL’s best blocking teams, MJ Phillips knows there is still plenty of work to be done on her end. The Chameleons have made their defensive presence felt with 59 kill blocks to win their first four games in the All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series, but Phillips admitted that blocking remains one of the more challenging parts of her game despite how effortless it may look to others. “Blocking is hard for me.
